run_flux_pipeline: run the FluxPipeline __call__ method to generate images from text prompts with configurable guidance and inference steps
encode_flux_prompts: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders into prompt embeddings and pooled embeddings for Flux generation
prepare_flux_latents: prepare latent tensors with packing and image IDs for Flux transformer denoising loop
calculate_flux_shift: calculate the shift parameter mu for FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
retrieve_flux_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from num_inference_steps or custom timesteps or sigmas for Flux denoising
